general_changes: Dedicated test-distribution files under package/data surface even without a tests directory or matching output filename.
Size-prefiltered SHA256 checks find exact answer copies under unrelated names/formats; size alone is not a match.
Per-distribution coverage states inspected/candidate counts, including zero-candidate distributions.
semantics: All results are discovery hints. No automatic scientific answer judgment, unused-file selection or removal. Original strict ownership/hash/notice-preserving exclusion enforcement is unchanged.
limits: Synthetic packages plus reference/replay regression checks; no actual installed MDAnalysisTests fixture audit or new live model campaign. Not exhaustive filesystem/semantic inspection.
